content: Azazeteththan Beettiza Anjjo
Neni GODAA ne Xoossaas azazettiko hach ta nees immiza azazota ne ubbaa ammanettada naagikko izi nena biitta bolla diza kawoteththata ubbaafe bollara dhoqqu dhoqqu histtana.
Neni GODAA ne Xoossaas azazettiko hayssafe kaalliza anjjoti wurikka neyta gidana.
Neni katamaninne gaxaren anjjettida as gidana.
Ne nayti, ne biittan diza kaththa ayfey, ne miizati, dorsatinne deyshati ubbay anjjettana.
Ne kaththa gootaraynne maadday anjjettana.
Neni geladakka kezadakka anjjettana.
Ne morkketi ne bolla meto gaththiza wode GODAY istta ne sinththan kundisana; istti ne bolla issi baggara yaana; gido attiin laappun ogera neeppe baqatana.
GODAY ne kushey oykkida ubbaanne ne gootara ubbaa anjjana; qasse izi nees immida biittankka nena anjjana.
Neni GODAA ne Xoossaas azazettikonne ne iza azazota ubbaa polikko izi nees caaqqida qaalaa mala izi nena baas dumma shaakettida dere histtana.
Hessafe guye biitta bolla diza derey wurikka GODAA sunththi nenan xeygettizayssa be7idi nees yayyana.
GODAY nees immanaas kase ne aawatas caaqqida biittaa bolla nees daro nayta, daro mehenne keehi daro kath immana.
Ne kushe ooso ubbaa anjjanaassinne GODAY ne biittaas ira wodera bukisanaas ba minjja keeththaa, salo penge nees doyana; qasse neni daro kawoteththatas tal7anaappe attiin ooppeka haa tal7e ekkaka.
GODAY nena hu7e histtanappe attiin goyna histtenna; hach tani nees immiza ne GODAA azazo siyada hessa neni minththada kaalliko neni ubbaafe bolla gidanaappe attiin garse gidakka.
Tani nees hach immida ha azazotappe kare kezada eeqa xoossatas goynnanaassinne isttas ooththanaas bessenna.
Azazettontta Ixoy Ehiza Qanggeth
Qasse neni GODAA ne Xoossaas azazettontta ixxiko, tani nees immiza wogatanne azazota ne ammanettada naagontta ixxiko hayssafe kaalliza qanggeththati ne bolla gakkananne nena ekki baana.
Neni katamaninne gaxaren qanggettidaade gidana.
Ne kaththa gootaraynne maadday qanggettidaazi gidana.
Ne nayti, ne biittan diza kaththa ayfey, ne miizati, dorsatinne deyshati ubbay qanggettidaaz gidana.
Neni geladakka kezadakka qanggettidaade gidana.
Neni iita ooson GODAA aggida gishshas ne ooththiza ooson ubbaan ne mulera dhayana gakkanaas qanggeth, hirganne kawushshateth GODAY ne bolla ehana.
Neni laattanaas gelana biittayfe nena mulera dhayssana gakkanaas neeppe kichchontta iita harge GODAY ne bolla yeddana.
GODAY nena gilqateththan, mishoninne qoxon, madunththan, xuuggiza awaninne koshan nena dhayssana; ne kaththaa dhayssanaas kutul7enne lobe ne bolla yeddana.
Neeppe bollara ne ginan de7iza saloy xarqimala gidana; ne biittayka birata mala gidana.
GODAY ne biittan bukkiza iraa buuhenne gudulla kessana; neni biittafe dhayana gakkanaas gudullay saloppe duge bukkana.

GODAY ne morkketa sinththan neni xoonettana mala ooththana; neni istta bolla issi ogera baanashin isttafe attanaas laappunasora baqatana; biitta bolla diza kawoteththati ubbay ne bolla gakkizayssa be7idi hirgan kokkorana.
Ne ahay salo kafotassinne bazzo do7atas quma gidana; istta gooddana asikka deenna.
GODAY nena paxontta Gibxe dere hargen, kixan, giiyiza madunththaninne puuso hargen shocanna.
GODAY nena gooshshan, qooqeteththaninne dagaman yeggana.
Gallassa seetan neni qooqey tattafettiza mala tattafettana; ne ooththiza ubbay nees giigontta ixxana; neni ne de7o ubbaan un7etashenne bonqqettashe daana; nena maaddiza asekka demmaka.
Neni machcho ekkanaas geela7o giigsana; gido attiin hara asi izo dafi ekkana; ne keeth keexxanashin izan daakka; neni woyne mith tokkanashin iza ayfe go7ettaka.

Ne ayfey xeellishin ne mehe hara asi shukkana; gido attiin he ashozappe aykkoka maakka; ne harey neeppe bonqqetti ekettana; gido attiin nees guye simmenna; ne dorsati ne morkkes imettana; hessafe ashshanaas nena maaddanay deenna.
Ne ayfe sinththan ne attuma naytinne macca nayti hara kawoteththas imettana; istti simmiin be7ana gaada ne xeellishin ne ayfey doljumana; hessa digganaas nees ay wolqqayka deenna.
Ne biittaa kaththa ayfenne ne daabura kessida ubbaa hara dere asi maana; neni ne de7o ubbaan un7ettidaadenne qohettidaade gidana.
Neni ayfen be7iza ubbay nena gooshshana.
GODAY nees toho xugunththafe biidi hu7e binana gakkanaas miza paxontta iita madunththaninne kixan ne suulenne ne wodira shocanna.
GODAY nenanne neni ne bolla kawosana kawoza ha biittafe denththidi kase neninne ne aawati erontta hara kawoteth efana; intte heen miththafenne shuchchafe oosettida eeqa xoossatas goynnana.
GODAY neni laaletta biza kawoteththata ubbaa giddon nena qilccas, miichchassinne kadhes kessana.
Ne gaden ne daro kath zerana shin booley mishin attida guuththa kath shiishshana.
Neni woyne mith tokkanashin iza ayfeza go7ettaka; gaasoykka guxuney iza maana.
Ne deren awanka wogara miththi mokkanashin wodey gakkontta dishin ayfe qoqofana; hessa gishshas wogara zaytey nees deenna.
Neni macca naytanne attuma nayta yelanashin istti olan di7etti biikko ne mela attana.
Ne gaden diza miththaanne kaththaa ubbaa booley maana.
Ne wolqqay daaburi daaburi bishin ne deren diza bete asaa wolqqay minni minni baana.
Ne deren diza bete asay nees tal7e immana attiin ne isttas tal7aka; istti nees hu7e gidana; neni gidikko isttas goyna gidana.
Neni GODAA ne Xoossas azazettontta ixxida gishshassinne izi nees immida wogatanne azazota neni naagontta ixxida gishshas neni mulera dhayana gakkanaas hayti ha qanggeththati ubbay ne bolla gakkana.
Ha qanggeththati ubbay Xoossi ne bollanne ne zereththata bolla qixaates yeggida mernaas malaatanne malalisizaaz gidana.
GODAA ne Xoossay nena daro baggara anjjides; gido attiin ne galatashe ufayssan izas ooththabeekka.
Hessa gishshas neni gafan, saamon, kalloteththaninne meto ubbaan GODAY ne bolla yeddiza ne morkketas ne haarettana; GODAY nena dhayssana gakkanaas ne morgen birata qambara waaxana.
GODAY ne istta qaala erontta kawoteth haako dereppe ne bolla ehana; isttika golle kafo mala ne bolla wodhdhana.
Istti menxe iitata, cimmida asaa bonchchonttaytanne guuththa naytas mishettonttayta gidana.

Istti ne mehenne ne kath ubbaa pitti mizayta gidida gishshas neni hayqqana gakkanaas koshan waayana; istti ne dhayana gakkanaas ne kaththaafe issi ayfe, ne meheppe guuththa mari, ne dorsafe guuththa laaqqa, woyneppenne wogara miththa ayfeppe qii palakka ashshettenna.

Ne biittan de7iza neni isttan ammanettiza adussanne mino dirsati ubbasora laalettana gakkanaas ne katamata ubbaa yuushon dooddidi nena un7eththana. GODAA ne Xoossay nees immida biitta ubbaa yuushon dooddi ne miixata dippi histti dhayssana.
Ne morkketi ne katamata dooddidi nena un7eththiin nees mizaazi dhayiin ne metotiza wode GODAA ne Xoossay nees immida ne uloppe yelettida macca naytanne attuma nayta asho dosay baynda ne maana.
Ne giddon haray atto kase kiyanne injje duussi dees geetettiza asikka ba ishaas, ba siiqiza machcheyssinne ba yelida naytas qadhettenna.
Guyen katama dooddidi un7eththida gaason maana miishshi haray baynda gishshas ba miza ba nayta ashoppe haras oonaska immenna.
Ne giddon kase injjen de7awus geetettidaara ba injje duussafe dendoyssan sa7a yedhdhanaas shaatettiza maccassayakka ba siiqiza azinaassinne ba naytas qadhettuku.

Morkkey iza de7iza katamaa dooddidi izo un7eththida gishshassinne tuggasida gishshas izis miza miishshi haray aykkoyka deenna; Hessa gishshas iza ba yelida yidhanne do7aa ba siiqiza azinaanne ba nayta gaththontta uuzettada geeman barkka maana.
Hayssa ha maxaafan xaafettida Xoossa wogaa intte lo7eththi naagontta aggiko qasse malalisizanne yashissiza GODAA intte Xoossa sunththaa intte bonchchontta aggiko,
GODAY intte bollanne intte nayta bolla babisiza bosha, simmontta bashshinne paxontta deexo harge intte bolla yeggana.
Neni Gibxe biitta bolla wodhdhiin beyada hirgida he iita hargeza ubbaa izi ne bolla yeddana; nekka he hargezappe paxakka.
GODAA wogati xaafettida ha maxaafan xaafettontta hara boshata inttena ubbaa wursana gakkanaas intte bolla yeddana.
GODAA intte Xoossaas intte azazettontta ixxida gishshas salo xoolintte mala darida inttefe guuththati xalla attana.
GODAY inttena duresanaassinne intte qooda darsanaas dosida mala qasseka inttena guuththishenne biittafe dhayssishe izi ufayettana; intteka laattanaas biza biittayfe shodettana.
GODAY nena kumeththa alamen diza asaa giddon biittas gaxappe gaxa gakkanaas laallana; heen neninne ne aawati kase goynni erontta miththafenne shuchchafe oosettida eeqa xoossatas intte goynnana.

He kawoteththata giddon intte woppa demmeketa; intte toho caammay yedhdhiza soho keena gadeykka inttes deenna; hessan GODAY inttes meto qofan xalla kumida hu7e, amon xalla daaburda ayfenne hidota qanxxiza wozina immana.
Inttes duussay ubba wode waaye xalla gidana; duussay ammanththontta gishshas intte qammanne gallas hirgishe daana.
Intte wozinan kumida hirgafenne intte ayfen be7iza palappe dendidayssan gadey wontishin intte, «Ayde qammaneesha!» qasse gadey qammishin, «Ayde wonttaneesha!» gaana.

Tani inttena, «Nam7anththo ha ogezara beekketa» gida ogezara GODAY inttena zaaridi markaben guye Gibxe yeddana. Heen intte aylle gidanaas intte morkketas inttena bayzanaas koyana; gido attiin inttena ayllesanaas shammiza as demmeketa.
